creator: Alexander Terp
description: terminal::a_program_on_the_alternate_screen_is_read_without_the_history_beneath_it (crates/muster-daemon/tests/daemon/terminal.rs:124) failed 1 of 3 alone under x86_64 emulation: the read after the program left the alternate screen still held its two lines, with history only from row24. It passed 6 of 6 on native aarch64 Linux and on macOS. Likely an existing race emulation exposes.
title: An alternate-screen read test fails under x86_64 emulation
